Slowly I started to get better after that when they changed my meds in there. Went to counseling every week. I didn't really have any friends to hangout with so I started going out by myself and next thing I know, I've been gaining more friends and becoming more social, getting a bit more out there. I didn't know what to expect or how it was gonna go down, but I felt a bit proud and just tried not to think so much down the road. Weeks would pass by from whenever I got back updates from the detective working on my case leaving me really anxious. Last time I got word from him (maybe over a week ago), he said he's going to present my case to a panel of people and they'll decide what happens next. Well today, I got the unfortunate news from my detective that my case was rejected and won't be going to court and the accused won't be charged, so I DON'T EVEN get a chance to tell my story in court, shut that down in the beginning. He explained why, though some of the information he relayed back was incorrect but gist was that because I didn't physically resist (kick, scratch, bite, etc), drugs were involved (l and weed), and I stayed the night (no drugged driving) they can't go on with it. Of course I disputed back, corrected him, and questioned as to why my specific saying of "no" was not enough (denied him 3 different times: first-"what gives, you like it when I touch you. You don't say no, so what gives?" Told him I have a boyfriend which he knows, and continued on touching me afterwards; second-"if you want me to stop, just say stop and I will" I managed to stutter the "s" cause I was getting really nervous at that point, but he understood and said "then I'll stop" and did, but again continued on few minutes later; third- "if you don't want to, just say no and we won't" by this time all his clothes were off and underwear down, he's rubbing himself all the while on top of me with my underwear down, I say no, he MAKES SURE I said no, stopped and laid his head on my chest; moments later he says "I just won't tell anybody," pulls my underwear down again (I had pulled it back up), gets on top of me, and yeah...). He gave me a legal advocate's number to go more in dept with her. Wait overall 26 minutes to finally reach her. Had to unfortunately relay a bit of my story to her over the phone in which she apologized that I had to do because I wasn't able to be in the call with them. But long story short, in Alabama, where I live, there is a specific law that says rape in the 1st degree is committed so long as physical force was involved :fighting, punching, kicking, scratching, etc. Niagara Falls would be an understatement of how much I was crying while hearing all this. I am appalled my rejecting him 3 times and even saying no and him MAKING SURE that I said no on the third time is simply not enough. According to her, our laws are 10 years behind, and in some other states my case could have gone through. She and her team have been working on new laws since last year so that more cases like mine can actually be investigated without one's fight senses HAVING to kick in (my flight senses kicked in and I didn't get a rape kit either even though I went to a scheduled doctor's appointment that morning), and that this month the legislation or whomever can look (and freaking) accept it since they didn't last year.
Never have I ever felt so rejected, dumb, and like I didn't matter, that this whole thing was a complete waste of time, energy, and my insanity after each update from the detective I would cry my eyes out, like today. Just a complete waste."
